definitions.explanation: A warm golden-brown color resembling ripe wheat. Often used to describe sun-tanned skin or hair color.

examples.japanese: {麦色|むぎいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{健康的|けんこうてき}だ。
⟦{夏|なつ}の{終|お}わり→夏の終わり：26768_natsunoowari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{子|こ}どもたち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧{麦色|むぎいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{日焼|ひや}けしていた→日焼けする：20314_hiyakesuru⟧。
examples.english: By the end of summer, all the children had tanned to a golden brown.

examples.japanese: {麦色|むぎいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}っていた→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
examples.english: A woman with wheat-colored hair was sitting in the café.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{麦|むぎ}→麦：05427_mugi⟧ (wheat/barley) and ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧ (color). A poetic and evocative color word frequently used in literature and everyday description. The most common usage is to describe a healthy, sun-tanned complexion, especially in summer contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {麦色|むぎいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧: wheat-colored skin, sun-tanned skin
- {麦色|むぎいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{焼|や}ける→焼ける：01138_yakeru⟧: to tan to a golden brown
- {麦色|むぎいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧: wheat-colored hair

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{小麦色|こむぎいろ}→小麦色：15107_komugiiro⟧: wheat color — nearly synonymous but more commonly used for describing tanned skin
- ⟦{黄金色|こがねいろ}→黄金色：19037_koganeiro⟧: golden color — brighter and more vivid than wheat color
- ⟦{褐色|かっしょく}→褐色：14115_kasshoku⟧: brown — a more neutral, less poetic term for dark skin tones
